title: Petros Stanitis, Enquiry From Greek Consulate General

page_data.en:
FM. 2.
G. 40M-9-35

202-C
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 7/7/4
Date April 23, 1936.

Subject Petros Stanaitis, enquiry from Greek Consulate General.

Made by D.P.S. Henchman Forwarded by I. I. J. Lyon.

Enquiries in respect of Petros Stanaitis have elicited the
following information:
Stanaitis was born in Preni, Lithuania, in 1896. He arrived
in Shanghai on the s.s. Stuttgart from Genoa on 18th January
1936 and was in possession of Iran passport No. 89829 issued
in Teheran on 12th September 1934, and visaed at the Chinese
legation in Vienna on 3rd December 1935. He travelled to
China via Port Said and Singapore and on arrival in Shanghai
went to the Park Hotel where he occupied room No. 819. On
28th January he left the hotel and went to a lodging house
kept by Mrs. Anne Cherniak at 415 Rue Cardinal Mercier
(Tel. 70853) where he is still resident.
On his landing declaration form, Stanaitis describes himself
as a Lithuanian, he is not, however, known to the Chairman of
the Lithuanian Association in Shanghai; and although he is in
possession of an Iran passport he is not known or registered
at the Iranian Consulate. The Paulun Hospital authorities
have no record of Stanaitis among their lists of patients.
Further inquiries in progress.

J.B.
24/4

Henchman
D. P. S.

P.A. to C.P.
Information
Thos Robertson
24/4/36

Officer i/c Special Branch.

202-C
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特科第二股
报告
档案号 7/7/4
日期 1936年4月23日。

事由 佩特罗斯·斯塔奈蒂斯（Petros Stanaitis），希腊总领事馆的查询。

由 D.P.S. 亨奇曼（Henchman）制作，经 I. I. J. 莱昂（Lyon）转呈。

关于佩特罗斯·斯塔奈蒂斯的调查已获取以下信息：
斯塔奈蒂斯于1896年出生于立陶宛普雷尼（Preni）。他于1936年1月18日乘坐“斯图加特”号轮船（s.s. Stuttgart）从热那亚抵达上海，持有1934年9月12日在德黑兰签发的伊朗护照第89829号，该护照于1935年12月3日经中国驻维也纳公使馆签证。他经由塞得港和新加坡前往中国，抵达上海后入住国际饭店（Park Hotel），占用819号房间。1月28日，他离开酒店，搬至梅神父路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）415号由安妮·切尔尼亚克（Anne Cherniak）太太经营的寄宿舍（电话 70853），目前仍居住于此。
在其入境申报单上，斯塔奈蒂斯自称是立陶宛人，然而，上海立陶宛协会主席并不认识此人；尽管他持有伊朗护照，但伊朗领事馆并无其记录或登记信息。宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital）当局在其病人名单中也没有斯塔奈蒂斯的记录。
进一步调查正在进行中。

J.B.
4月24日

亨奇曼
D. P. S.

警察局长私人助理
情报
托马斯·罗伯逊（Thos Robertson）
1936年4月24日

特科主管警官。

08
April 21, 36.

Sir,
I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No. 298 dated April 21, 1936,
in regard to the present whereabouts of Petros
Stanaitis, and in reply to inform you that the
matter is receiving attention.
The result of action taken will be communicated
to you in due course.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard.
Commissioner of Police.

The Acting Consul General for Greece,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
08
1936年4月21日。

先生，
谨此确认收到您1936年4月21日第298号来函，事关佩特罗斯·斯塔奈蒂斯目前的下落，现回复告知，此事正在处理中。
采取行动的結果将在适当时候通知您。

谨致
敬礼，

（签名）F. W. 杰拉德（F. W. Gerrard）。
警察局长。

希腊驻上海代理总领事。

CONSULATE GENERAL FOR GREECE
SHANGHAI
No.200.

B. D.

Shanghai. April 21st, 1936.

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Sir:

Re: Petros Staneitis.

I have the honour to request your
assistance in tracing the present where-
abouts of the above Greek subject, who
according to my information arrived in
Shanghai early this Year, lived in the
Park Hotel which he left on the 28th
January to enter the Paulun Hospital,
22 Burkill Road.

Any information that you might be
able to give me will be very highly
appreciated.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Emm. P. Yannoulatos,
Acting Consul General.
page_data.zh:
希腊驻上海总领事馆
上海
第200号。

B. D.

上海。1936年4月21日。

警察局长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

先生：

事由：佩特罗斯·斯塔内伊蒂斯（Petros Staneitis）。

谨请贵处协助查找上述希腊籍人士目前的下落。据我方掌握的信息，他于今年初抵达上海，曾居住于国际饭店，并于1月28日离开该酒店，进入位于伯基尔路（Burkill Road）22号的宝隆医院。

如蒙提供任何相关信息，不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，

埃姆. P. 扬努拉托斯（Emm. P. Yannoulatos），
代理总领事。

CONSULATE GENERAL FOR GREECE
SHANGHAI

No. 435.

Shanghai. May 2nd, 1936.

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Sir:

I have the honour to acknowledge
receipt of your letter of April 28th,
in regard to the whereabouts of Petros
Stanlitis, for which I wish to express
my thanks and appreciation.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant
Em. P. Yannoulatos.
Acting Consul General.

希腊驻上海总领事馆
上海

第435号。

上海。1936年5月2日。

警察局长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

先生：

谨此确认收到您4月28日关于佩特罗斯·斯坦利蒂斯（Petros Stanlitis）下落的来函，对此我谨表示谢意和赞赏。

谨致
敬礼，

埃姆. P. 扬努拉托斯（Em. P. Yannoulatos）。
代理总领事。

page_data.en:
April 25, 36.

Sir,

Further to my letter dated April 21, 1936, in regard
to the whereabouts of Petros Stanaitis, I have the honour
to inform you that Police enquiries have shown that he is
at present residing in a lodging house kept by Mrs. Anne
Cherniak at No.415 Rue Cardinal Mercier (Tel. 70853).

The Paulun Hospital authorities state that they have
no record of Petros Stanaitis having been one of their patients.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police.

The Acting Consul General for Greece,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
1936年4月25日。

先生，

继我1936年4月21日关于佩特罗斯·斯塔奈蒂斯下落的信函之后，谨此告知，警方调查显示，他目前居住在梅神父路415号由安妮·切尔尼亚克太太经营的寄宿舍（电话 70853）。

宝隆医院当局表示，他们没有佩特罗斯·斯塔奈蒂斯曾为其病人的记录。

谨致
敬礼，

（签名）F. W. 杰拉德
警察局长。

希腊驻上海代理总领事。
